links.outcome: Annotation inconsistencies in reference labels confounding interpretation of LLM errors
links.effect: Many failures stem from misalignment between model reasoning and dataset annotation conventions; labels without rationales cannot separate model reasoning failures from annotation mismatches.
links.quote: Labels without rationales make it impossible to distinguish clinical reasoning failures from annotation convention mismatches.

unlisted_practices: Reasoning-annotated datasets that document why spans are actionable
Two-stage staged-prompting extraction of actionable tasks from discharge notes

screen.reason: Empirical benchmarking study evaluating zero-shot/few-shot LLMs versus supervised models for extracting clinical action items from discharge summaries using an existing dataset.
